jobs.description:
Position overview:
 

 
 

You manage the plant’s environmental, health and safety (EHS), fire safety and property protection (FSPP) sustainability programmes to ensure the safety and well-being of all workers and protection of the environment. You also provide advice and guidance to plant management on EHS, FSPP, sustainability issues, and proactively management of EHS and FSPP risks to ensure the plant meets it compliance obligations and Ball requirements and implements best practice. Coordinate EHS activity, including EHS management systems (ISO and ASI) (certified where applicable). Accountable for rolling out Ball EHS BOE (Ball Operational Excellence) and sustainability initiatives.
 

 
 

Key responsibilities include:
 

 
 
 

• Develop and implement BBS and proactive reporting and engagement initiatives such as near miss, hazard and/or good catch to promote safe behaviours and develop a positive safety culture. 

• Identify and ensure compliance with EHS compliance obligations (e.g. laws, regulations, permits, licences etc) and other stakeholder requirements (e.g. FSPP insurance). 

• Ensure plant management and workers are aware of, take ownership and deliver on their respective EHS accountabilities and responsibilities, including deputies to cover absences. Escalate issues promptly to the plant manager and Regional EHS. 

• Implement and maintain hazard identification and risk assessment programme that reflects hazards during normal, abnormal and emergency conditions and apply the hierarchy of control. Incorporates the Ball BOE, LiFE and hazard mapping into risk management programmes. 

• Identify and assess environment aspects and manage significant impacts under normal, abnormal and emergency conditions including emissions to air, waste, water, wastewater, energy and VOCs. Implement programs to manage significant impacts such as waste minimisation management strategy, pollution prevention, ecological issues. Manage environmental protection infrastructure. 

• Manage the timely reporting, recording, investigation and identification of root causes of EHS incidents and complaints along with oversight of corrective actions including Global reporting via Enablon and Alerts. 

• Work with functional department leaders to develop and implement EHS programmes, requirements, rules, procedures, systems to manage EHS risk and meet all EHS requirements and drive continuous improvement. 

• Establish and implement robust communication and consultation channels to raise awareness, drive engagement, provide information on EHS issues including oversight of the EHS committee and liaison with Safety Representatives. 

• Implement and maintain integrated EHS management systems (and where applicable maintain certification to ISO 14001, ISO 45001, BRC, food safety standards and integrated with ISO 9001) including oversight of external and internal audits, FSPP surveys and management reviews. Follows up on corrective actions. 

• Implement occupational / industrial hygiene, occupational health and well-being programmes in accordance with identified risks and legal requirements in consultation with HR and external providers. 

• Act as primary liaison with regulatory authorities and other external stakeholders (for example insurers, auditors) and internal stakeholders (Regional and Global EHS, Group Insurance, Group Security) and ensure their requirements and reporting are dealt with efficiently. 

What are we looking for?
 

 
 
 

• Min. 5 years of EHS experience, with 3 years management in a similar industry, with proactive shopfloor engagement and comprehensive knowledge of EHS risks and issues. 

• Relevant EHS qualification to a high level (minimum diploma or local equivalent); alternatively engineering qualification with relevant experience of at least 3 years in an EHS managerial role in manufacturing, heavy engineering or construction. 

• Comprehensive knowledge of EHS legislative requirements. 

• Working knowledge of implementing behaviour-based safety programmes. 

• Managing fire safety and property protection insurance risks. 

• Excellent computer skills (Proficient in MS Office Suite). 

• Fluent in written and spoken English and Dutch.

For a new company specializing in second-hand e-bikes located in Mechelen, we are seeking skilled bicycle technicians.

Proficiency in Dutch, French, or English is required.

The initial selection will be based on your resume. We look forward to learning more about your skills and experience. 
Your application is the first step in joining a team that values expertise and dedication in the field of bicycle refurbishment.

VetPharm Global is an international partner in animal health, specialising in the distribution of veterinary medicines, vaccines and feed additives. From our head office in Belgium and through a commercial network and operations in Europe, Asia and South America, we support vets, producers and pharmaceutical companies with innovative and scientifically backed solutions. with a strong focus on quality, expertise and customer focus, we contribute to sustainable and effective animal health.
 

To support the further growth of our operations in Brazil, we are seeking an enterprising Regional Manager. 
 

What does the role involve?
 

Location: Paulínia, São Paulo, Brazil 

Reports to: Global Management Team 
 

As Regional Manager Brazil, you will act as the link between our Belgian organisation and our branches in Brazil. You will manage the day-to-day operations of one branch, support its further development and foster collaboration between the various companies.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

• You will manage the day-to-day operations and further development of one of our Brazilian branches 

• You will optimise processes and coordinate production, quality, logistics and administration. 

• You will lead the local team and monitor budgets, KPIs and results. 

• You act as the link between the Brazilian branches and the Belgian organisation.

• You oversee strategic projects and support growth and investment initiatives.

• You 
hold a master’s degree or have equivalent experience.

• Experience in setting up or further developing an organisation is a significant asset. 

• You combine strong organisational and communication skills with a hands-on approach and strategic insight. 

• You are an inspiring leader who knows how to bring people together and take responsibility 

• You work independently and take the initiative 

• You communicate fluently in Portuguese and English; knowledge of Dutch is an advantage.

SAS Global (Scientific Allied Solutions) is an independent partner in animal health, specialising in veterinary diagnostics, autogenous vaccines and contract research. With various subsidiaries and our head office in Belgium, and an international presence across Europe, Asia, Jordan and Brazil, we support vets, farmers and pharmaceutical companies with innovative solutions for healthier animals and more efficient production.
 

To support the continued growth of our three Brazilian subsidiaries, we are seeking an enterprising Regional Manager.
 

What does the role involve?
 

Location: Paulínia, São Paulo, Brazil 

Reports to: Global Management Team 
 

As Regional Manager Brazil, you will act as the link between our Belgian organisation and our branches in Brazil. You will manage the day-to-day operations of one branch, support its further development and foster collaboration between the various companies.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

• You will manage the day-to-day operations and further development of one of our Brazilian branches 

• You will optimise processes and coordinate production, quality, logistics and administration. 

• You will lead the local team and monitor budgets, KPIs and results. 

• You act as the link between the Brazilian branches and the Belgian organisation. 

• You foster collaboration and implement group-wide strategies and procedures. 

• You oversee strategic projects and support growth and investment initiatives. 

• You contribute to the long-term strategy for Brazil. 

• You build lasting relationships with customers, partners and government bodies. 
 

• You 
hold a master’s degree or have equivalent experience. 

• You have at least five years’ management experience in an international environment. 

• Experience in setting up or further developing an organisation is a significant asset. 

• You combine strong organisational and communication skills with a hands-on approach and strategic insight. 

• You are an inspiring leader who knows how to bring people together and take responsibility 

• You work independently and take the initiative 

• You communicate fluently in Portuguese and English; knowledge of Dutch is an advantage.

Let's talk business
 
 

• As an International Sales Manager you will be responsible for selling MES-systems to B2B customers in the global growth markets of textiles and plastics. 

• You focus on medium and large enterprises, and you'll speak to strategic decision makers (owners, general management, IT and production management). 

• In the countries where you operate, you will work together with sales agents. You research the market potential of your countries, select quality partners with a good reputation, evaluate their activities and visit prospects whose doors they will open. 

• You are responsible for preparing offers, launching marketing campaigns and making presentations. 

• You participate in national and international fairs. 

• You think along with the customer and convince them that BMS is their suitable partner for their Industry 4.0 strategy. 

Let's talk you
 
 

• You hold a technical or technical/economic Master's degree or you've built up equivalent expertise through experience, and you have a strong affinity with software-driven solutions. 

• Ideally, you bring around 10 years of experience in Sales or Business Development, preferably within the manufacturing industry, where you have successfully positioned business operations or MES-related software. 

• You feel at ease collaborating with stakeholders at different levels and you have a proven track record in complex, project-driven sales environments with longer sales cycles. 

• You love to travel internationally frequently and you are interested in other cultures. 

• You communicate fluently in English, and any additional language skills, such as French, German, Italian, etc., are a strong asset. 

• Continuous learning energizes you. You enjoy negotiating, building long-term relationships and taking ownership. 

• You combine an entrepreneurial mindset with strong self-management skills, all within a collaborative corporate culture where pragmatism, intrapreneurship and responsibility truly matter.

Scope
 

The project leader’s role is to technically manage IC design and supply projects to ensure technical quality and timely delivery. 
 

Responsibilities
 

Be the technical lead for an entire project, taking into account customer milestones and making sure technical specifications and quality standards are met:
 
 

• Daily follow-up of all project team members: designers, layouters, testers 

• Support and coach team members with technical expertise and strong problem solving skills 

• Maintain detailed overview and knowledge of the complete mixed-signal development 

• Organize, lead, attend internal status meetings to keep abreast about the project progress 

• Be the technical point of contact for the customer 

• Write the IC design specification and ensure a timely update in case of customer change requests 

• Ensure compliance with all safety and quality standards 

• Closely work together with and report potential problems on time to the Project Manager  
  
 

Competences
 
 

• You are a dynamic and highly motivated engineer in micro-electronics 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant industrial work experience 

• You are an experienced user of the mixed-signal flow of Cadence and/or Synopsys and Matlab 

• You have strong communication and reporting skills, also in English 

• You demonstrate excellent analytical and problem solving skills

Responsibilities
 
 

• Study, specification, design and verification of high-quality digital and mixed-signal ICs 

• Write digital specifications for mixed-signal ICs, make area and power estimations 

• Technical team lead for the digital content of mixed-signal ASICs including interaction with customers, suppliers and the internal ASIC development team 

• Lead, attend and present at project/review meetings worldwide 

• Coach junior engineers in design, verification and testing of integrated circuits and improve their level of technical expertise and knowledge of the total business 

• Work together with international customers and communicate efficiently to successfully complete the project 

• Write documentation 
 

• You are a dynamic and highly motivated engineer with at least four years of experience in digital IC design 

• You have experience with front-end ASIC or FPGA design in VHDL and/or Verilog and/or SystemVerilog 

• You have experience with front-end verification, preferably in SystemVerilog + UVM, to write directed tests, constrained randomized tests and to gather and interpret metrics such as code/condition/FSM/toggle/functional coverage 

• You have experience with digital synthesis, logic equivalence checking (LEC) and Static Timing Analysis (STA) 

• Experience with UPF and/or CPF and DFT and ATPG is a plus 

• Experience with scripting and programming languages such as Python and C is a plus 

• Experience with any of the following protocols and techniques is a plus: SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, LIN, SENT, DSP, CRC, FSM design, MCU 

• You are a self-motivated, efficient professional able to work alone or in teams 

• You offer quality and reliability to colleagues, customers and management, willing to share knowledge and able to communicate efficiently 

• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken
